# IP database test fixture

`GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb` is the small synthetic MaxMind test database from
https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/main/test-data (retrieved 2026-09-15).
It is used only by automated tests, never as production location data.
